title: CLEAR: Legible and Steerable Recommendation via Grounded Natural-Language Interests
abstract: arXiv:2611.19110v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern recommenders keep learned preferences in representations people cannot inspect or change. We present CLEAR (Controllable and Legible End-to-end Architecture for Recommendation), an end-to-end system deployed at Meta and built around an editable natural-language interest layer. CLEAR makes a ranked subset of inferred interests readable and stores accepted additions and suppressions as authoritative preference state. Behavioral grounding maps each inferred interest back to supporting events in the user's own history. The resulting interest object is also a serving address: its label and profile-conditioned rewrites drive lexical retrieval, its supporting events seed behavioral retrieval, its projection queries an embedding index, and its stable identity supports ranking, attribution, and exposure control. translated_title: CLEAR：基于有据可依的自然语言兴趣实现清晰可读且可引导的推荐
translated_abstract: 现代推荐系统将学习到的用户偏好存储在用户无法查看或修改的表示形式中。我们提出了CLEAR（Controllable and Legible End-to-end Architecture for Recommendation，可控制且清晰可读的端到端推荐架构），这是一个部署于Meta的端到端系统，围绕可编辑的自然语言兴趣层构建。CLEAR使推断出的兴趣的排序子集变得可读，并将用户接受的添加和抑制操作存储为权威的偏好状态。行为扎根机制将每个推断出的兴趣映射回用户自身历史中支持该兴趣的事件。由此形成的兴趣对象同时也是一个服务地址：其标签及基于用户画像的条件性改写驱动词汇检索，其支持事件为行为检索提供种子，其投影用于查询嵌入索引，其稳定身份支持排序、归因和曝光控制。用户的新声明可以先于行为支持而存在，因此它通过相同的服务身份进入系统，并初步吸引候选……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: CLEAR是Meta部署的端到端推荐系统，其核心创新是通过可编辑的自然语言兴趣层让推荐偏好清晰可读、可由用户引导，每个推断出的兴趣都以用户历史事件为行为依据，并作为统一的服务地址同时驱动词汇检索、行为检索、嵌入检索以及排序、归因和曝光控制。
en_tdlr: CLEAR is an end-to-end recommender deployed at Meta whose key innovation is an editable natural-language interest layer that makes preferences legible and steerable, grounding each inferred interest in supporting behavioral events and using it as a unified serving address for lexical, behavioral, and embedding retrieval as well as ranking, attribution, and exposure control.
